segments.contentSummary: Text:Ramses II, 'the Great,' ruled 1279–1213 BC, Egypt's longest reign at 66 years.
Text:Rise to Power: Seti I's son, early coregent trained for war; built Per-Ramesses Delta capital. Resumed Abydos temple and visited Thebes for Opet festival.
Text:Fathered 100+ children; Nefertari featured at Abu Simbel.
